summary: The customer called because they were having trouble setting up a newly purchased Fiber Home router, specifically with the internet light showing red. The agent guided the customer step-by-step to fix the cable connection and configure the PPPoE settings. The issue was successfully resolved, and the internet light turned solid green.

rubric_scores.justification: The agent was polite, encouraging, and maintained a helpful demeanor throughout the call.

evidence.text: ولا مهندس، ولا يهمك، خليني أساعدك فيه خطوة بخطوة.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent immediately reassured the customer and validated their frustration with a friendly and supportive tone.

evidence.text: يا سلام، ضوت أخضر ثابت! يعني خلص زبطت الأمور؟
evidence.speaker: Customer

rubric_scores.justification: The agent successfully guided the customer through all the necessary troubleshooting steps until the router was fully functional.

evidence.text: لازم تشبكه بالـ WAN port اللي بيكون لونه أزرق عادةً، مش الـ LAN.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: Instructions regarding ports, IP addresses, and menu navigation were clear and easy to follow.

evidence.text: الله يعافيك، يوم سعيد و مع السلامة!
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent offered further assistance, checked if the customer needed anything else, and closed the call politely.

evidence.text: روح على الـ Quick Setup أو Network Settings، ودور على خانة الـ WAN connection.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: All technical guidance provided, including default credentials and setup paths, was accurate.

evidence.text: أكبس على Save بعدين Apply، وخلينا نستنى ثواني لحد ما يعمل reboot لحاله.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent followed the proper logical sequence of troubleshooting and configuration procedures.

quote.text: بس عم بحاول أعمله setup ومش عم بشتغل معي مزبوط.
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: آه، فهمت عليك. طيب خليني أغيره ثواني... تمام، نقلته وصار بالـ WAN port.
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: ضبطت معي! هسا طلعت لي القائمة الرئيسية، وين أروح من هون؟
quote.speaker: Customer
